description: Template-completeness advisories for the explicit cn/et callback profile on the exact MRM /ad/l/1 route. The public SDK and gallery producer establish these fields on network-host callbacks. Opaque s-only transports remain outside this profile; event vocabularies, issued-token validity and session attribution are not verified.

params.name: cn
params.description: EventCallback.getUrl retains an event name in cn and the public gallery VAST templates populate it. This is a source-template completeness advisory. New event names are not rejected.

params.name: et
params.description: EventCallback.getUrl writes the event-type field and the public gallery response emits it. Its value vocabulary is not closed by this profile.

params.name: s
params.description: The reviewed public gallery callbacks retain this nonempty opaque field. Presence is observed template completeness, not a signature-validity, delivery or vendor mandatory-field claim.
